searched_by: DeAIodorant research agent under maintainer direction
purpose: Locate deterministic methods and relevant Mandarin evidence for distinguishing word-level modifier-attachment or phrase-bracketing competition from character-to-word segmentation ambiguity.
queries: OpenAlex and Crossref: Chinese nominal compound bracketing ambiguity
OpenAlex and Crossref: Chinese noun phrase modifier attachment ambiguity
OpenAlex and Crossref: Chinese compound internal structure prediction PMI
OpenAlex and Crossref: Chinese compound bracketing
OpenAlex and Crossref: Chinese nominal compound
OpenAlex and Crossref: Mandarin compound processing
OpenAlex and Crossref: Chinese compound parsing
OpenAlex and Crossref: noun compound bracketing corpus statistics
OpenAlex and Crossref: unsupervised noun compound bracketing association
OpenAlex and Crossref: compound noun bracketing dependency probabilities
Crossref: Chinese noun compound interpretation; Chinese nominal compound interpretation; Chinese noun-noun compound structure; Mandarin nominal compound ambiguity
Semantic Scholar: the first three broad queries above
OpenAlex exact DOI lookups for the six sources retained in the evidence ledger
language_limits: English metadata and abstracts; Chinese-language papers may be under-retrieved.
inclusion_scope: Primary or review sources describing noun-compound bracketing, dependency or association-based structural disambiguation, hidden relation paraphrasing, Mandarin compound representation, or processing effects of word frequency, semantic transparency, and word structure.
exclusion_scope: Biomedical and materials-science uses of compound or attachment, unrelated bracket alignment, and sources without an operational implication for the present deterministic measurement problem.
known_limitations: This was a bounded methods search, not a systematic review or novelty search.
Crossref relevance was poor for several broad queries because the terms compound and attachment are highly polysemous.
Semantic Scholar returned HTTP 429 for all three queries from its anonymous shared pool.
OpenAlex returned bounded partial pages and then exhausted the daily anonymous search budget; the later two method queries returned HTTP 429.
Only metadata and indexed abstracts were screened; full-text method verification remains the accountable human reviewer's responsibility.
Most located bracketing methods were developed for English noun compounds; transfer to Chinese technical prose is an unvalidated analogy.
last_result_screened_or_stop_rule: Screen the first 25 OpenAlex and Crossref results for each broad query, the first 50 Crossref results for four Chinese-specific follow-ups, record API failures, and verify indexed abstracts for six retained seed sources by exact DOI.
